benchmarkContent:
-- $* Factory benchmark generated from semantic source summary only for mac_16
-- $* Source path: docs/codebase/macros/JDE_3D_items_extractor.pmlmac
-- $* Script for export all 3D elements into EXCEL report
-- $* Metadata comment: $m "file path" convention (original source path stored in macro header)


-- Create empty array object
!data = object array()

-- PML1 collect all: gather all SITE elements into a collection variable
var !sites collect all SITE

-- Iterate over collection values (not indices)
do !siteName values !sites
	-- Obtain a dbref for each site name string
	!siteRef = !siteName.dbref()
enddo
